```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(sf); library(terra); library(here)

reef  <- read.csv(here("data", "derived", "reef_2019_2026.csv"))          # made by R/02_clean_2026.R
sites <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "monitoring_gis.gpkg"), "reef_sites", quiet = TRUE)
land  <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "monitoring_gis.gpkg"), "land", quiet = TRUE)
zones <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "monitoring_gis.gpkg"), "mpa_zones", quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot(params$mpa %in% sites$mpa)

reef <- left_join(reef, st_drop_geometry(sites)[, c("site_id", "mpa", "zone")], by = "site_id")
mine <- filter(reef, mpa == params$mpa)
now  <- filter(mine, year == params$year)
m_now  <- round(mean(now$hard_coral), 1)
m_prev <- round(mean(mine$hard_coral[mine$year == params$year - 1]), 1)
```

# Summary

In `{r} params$year` the team surveyed `{r} nrow(now)` transects at
`{r} n_distinct(now$site_id)` sites of `{r} params$mpa`. Mean hard coral cover
was **`{r} m_now` %** (`{r} m_prev` % the year before).

# Methods

Sites were surveyed on three 20 m Point Intercept Transects per year, following
@hill2004.

# Results

## Coral cover since 2019

```{r}
#| label: fig-trend
#| fig-cap: "Mean hard coral cover (± SE) per year and zone."
se <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
mine %>% group_by(year, zone) %>% summarise(m = mean(hard_coral), se = se(hard_coral), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, m, colour = zone)) + geom_line() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m - se, ymax = m + se)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("No-take" = "#1b7f8c", "Fishing" = "#d9694a"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hard coral cover (%)") + theme_minimal()
```

@fig-trend shows the drop of 2024 and the recovery since.

## Map

```{r}
#| label: fig-map
#| fig-cap: "Change in hard coral cover since the year before, per site."
#| fig-height: 6
# TO DO: compute the change per site (pivot_wider), join it to `sites`,
#        and draw it with geom_sf() (diverging palette, scale bar, CRS in the caption)
ggplot() + geom_sf(data = land, fill = "#efe6d2") +
  geom_sf(data = filter(zones, mpa == params$mpa), aes(fill = zone), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = filter(sites, mpa == params$mpa)) +
  coord_sf(xlim = st_bbox(filter(zones, mpa == params$mpa))[c(1, 3)],
           ylim = st_bbox(filter(zones, mpa == params$mpa))[c(2, 4)]) +
  theme_minimal()
```
